# `org.settings.page`

Show organization settings

Page-only. Renders the zero-JS settings forms with a current entity tag.

- Method and path: `GET /{org}/-/settings`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie org settings page`
- MCP: `org_settings_page`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

Framework problems only.
